tooltip.imttech.red_dot_sight: A small open sight with a glowing red dot. You aim faster and tighter, and you still see your gun.
tooltip.imttech.sniper_scope: One scope that zooms from 1x to 10x and everything in between: scroll while you aim.
tooltip.imttech.suppressor_9mm: A suppressor for 9mm guns. The shot is far quieter and shows no muzzle flash, for a little less damage.
tooltip.imttech.suppressor_rifle: A suppressor for rifles. The shot is far quieter and shows no muzzle flash, for a little less damage.
tooltip.imttech.suppressor_shotgun: A suppressor for shotguns. The shot is far quieter and shows no muzzle flash, for a little less damage.
tooltip.imttech.vertical_grip: A grip under the handguard for your left hand: less recoil.
tooltip.imttech.angled_grip: A slanted grip under the handguard: you aim and draw faster.
tooltip.imttech.bipod: Two folding legs. Sneak and stand still: they fold down and the rifle barely kicks.
tooltip.imttech.tube_extension: A longer tube under the barrel: two more shells.
tooltip.imttech.attachment.how: Drag it onto a gun at a Gunsmith Table
gunsmith.imttech.no_fit: The %1$s does not fit on the %2$s
gunsmith.imttech.attachment_first: Take the %s off first: it sits on this part
tooltip.imttech.mp5: A 9mm submachine gun, built from six parts on a Gunsmith Table. 30 rounds in the magazine, one in the chamber. It shoots the same rounds as the Glock.
tooltip.imttech.ak_47: A 7.62x39mm assault rifle, built from six parts on a Gunsmith Table. 30 rounds in the magazine, one in the chamber. Hits harder and reaches further than the MP5, but it kicks.
tooltip.imttech.awp: A .338 Lapua Magnum bolt-action sniper rifle, built from six parts on a Gunsmith Table. 5 rounds in the magazine, one in the chamber. Work the bolt with R after every shot.
tooltip.imttech.remington_870: A 12 Gauge pump-action shotgun, built from six parts on a Gunsmith Table. 6 shells in the tube under the barrel, one in the chamber. Pump it with R after every shot; R also pushes shells into the tube, one at a time.
tooltip.imttech.magazine.for: A magazine for the %1$s (%2$s). Hold it and press R to push in one round at a time; right-click to put it into the gun in your hotbar.
tooltip.imttech.firearm.spent: Spent casing in the chamber: press R
tooltip.imttech.firearm.sling: Has a sling: fits a sling slot (back or chest)
tooltip.imttech.firearm.no_sling: No sling: hang a Gun Sling on it at a Gunsmith Table to carry it on your back
tooltip.imttech.firearm.keys_selector: Left click: fire. Right click: aim. R: reload / tap-rack. Sneak + R: chamber a round. X: fire selector. H: inspect
gun.imttech.cycle_first: Spent casing in the chamber: press R
gunsmith.imttech.no_sling: A sling does not fit on the %s
key.imttech.gun_fire_mode: Fire selector (firearm: safe, semi, burst, auto)

screen.imttech.pouch.hint_mag_pouch: Drag or shift-click magazines in and out
screen.imttech.pouch.hint_close: Also from the Alt wheel, or its own key
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.frame: The frame: the lower body, the stock and the grip. The base of the gun; worn, it draws slower.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.receiver: The receiver: the upper body with the slide, bolt or charging handle. Netherite kicks less; worn, it kicks more and reloads slower.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.emitter: The emitter: the barrel and its lens. Netherite hits harder; worn, it loses damage and range.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.optics: The optics: the sight or the scope. Worn optics spray.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.capacitor: The capacitor: holds the charge for a shot. Worn, every shot costs more of the cell.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.trigger: The trigger module: how fast the gun can fire. Worn, it fires slower.
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.material: %s: %s%% chance per shot to wear a point
tooltip.imttech.laser_part.broken: Broken. Replace it on a Laser Workbench.

tooltip.imttech.gun_sling: A strap for a Laser Rifle, Sniper or Shotgun: with a sling the gun fits a sling slot next to your armour.

tooltip.imttech.laser_gun.incomplete: Incomplete: %s part(s) missing. Finish it on a Laser Workbench.
